# Grab and investigate full gene tables

```{r}
pcawg.files <- list.files(file.path(paths$box, "data", "pancan_pcawg_2020"), 
                          full.names = TRUE)

pcawg.files
```

```{r}
mirna <- read.table(pcawg.files[grep("data_mirna.txt", pcawg.files)],
                    header = TRUE) 

head(mirna)
```


```{r}
pm <- 
  mirna %>%
  gather(-Hugo_Symbol, key = "sampleID", value = "FPKM") %>%
  spread(key = Hugo_Symbol, value = FPKM)

pm %>%
  select(contains("mir-210")) %>%
  gather(key = "miR", value = "FPKM") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(FPKM+1))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = miR)) +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave("../figures/pcawg_mir210_histogram.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r}
rna <-
  read.table(pcawg.files[grep("data_mrna_seq_fpkm.txt", pcawg.files)],
                    header = TRUE) 
```

# Use desired tables for correlation

```{r check for samples from KIRC that should be excluded}
clin <- read.table(pcawg.files[grep("data_clinical_sample.txt", pcawg.files)],
                   sep = "\t", header = T)

table(clin$ORGAN_SYSTEM)

clin.possbad <- clin %>%
  filter(ORGAN_SYSTEM == "KIDNEY")

clin.possbad %>%
  mutate(HISTOLOGY = as.character(HISTOLOGY)) %>%
  group_by(HISTOLOGY) %>%
  tally()

badsamps <- clin %>%
  filter(HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION %in% c("Kidney-RCC", "Kidney-ChRCC"))
```

```{r calculate buffa score}
checkGenes(as.character(rna$Hugo_Symbol), "Buffa")
alt.gene.names <- c("PNP", "HILPDA", "MRGBP", "AK3", "ESRP1", "CTSV")

buffain <- rna %>%
  mutate(Gene = as.character(Hugo_Symbol)) %>%
  select(-Hugo_Symbol) %>%
  select(-any_of(badsamps$SAMPLE_ID)) %>%
  select(-any_of(clin$SAMPLE_ID[is.na(clin$HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION)]))

rna.buffa <- calculateBuffa(buffain, c(inputGenes("Buffa"), alt.gene.names))
```

```{r format for correlation}
corr.in <- mirna %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Hugo_Symbol") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%
  mutate(MIR210 = log(`hsa-miR-210-3p` + 1)) %>%
  select(sample, MIR210) %>%
  left_join(rna.buffa)

table(is.na(corr.in$buffa.score))

corr.in <- corr.in %>%
  drop_na(buffa.score)
```

```{r statisitcal correlation test}
cor.test(corr.in$MIR210, corr.in$buffa.score)

lm(MIR210 ~ buffa.score, data = corr.in) %>%
  summary()
```

```{r plot buffa v mir210}
corr.in %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = buffa.score, y = MIR210)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score", y = "log(hsa-miR-210-3p + 1)") +
  theme_bw() 
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-vs-mir210.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r plot buffa v mir210 with cancer facet}
corr.can <- 
  corr.in %>%
  mutate(SAMPLE_ID = sample) %>%
  left_join(clin)

can.ord <- 
  corr.can %>%
  group_by(HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION) %>%
  summarize(mean.Buffa = mean(buffa.score)) %>%
  arrange(mean.Buffa)

corr.can %>% 
  left_join(can.ord) %>%
  mutate(HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION = fct_reorder(HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION, 
                                              mean.Buffa)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = buffa.score, y = MIR210)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(HISTOLOGY_ABBREVIATION), scales = "free") + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score", y = "log(hsa-miR-210-3p + 1)") +
  theme_bw() 
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-vs-mir210_facet.png",
       height = 10, width = 7.5)
```
